title: Clarification on Work Order Return Functionality – ERPNext v15

posts.name: Shazad Nazir
posts.cooked:
Clarification Needed on Work Order Return Functionality in ERPNext v15 - Non consumed Raw Material return from Work In Progress Warehouse back to Raw Material Warehouse

We are currently testing the Return functionality in Work Orders for non-consumed materials, specifically returning items from the Work In Progress (WIP) Warehouse back to the Raw Material Warehouse. We tried the options available in ERPNext v15 but were unable to achieve the expected behavior.

We also reviewed the following documentation:
https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/v14/user/manual/en/manufacturing/work-order#41-return-non-consumed-materials-to-the-stores-from-wip-warehouse

However, the steps in this documentation do not align with what we are experiencing in our ERPNext v15 environment.

Could you please guide us on the correct process for handling non-consumed material returns in Work Orders or confirm if this functionality has changed in v15?
I’m encountering a similar issue. Does anyone know how to handle it?
